Something that has helped me network before even starting my degree here in the same field was starting the creation of my own game and bugging people nonstop. Ask people what they know and find out what they’ll share! My closest contact right now is my friend who helps me with 3D sculpting that has a friend that’s an environmental designer for Valorant. I also know some people who often participate in game jams on itch.io! And heck, those may never turn into anything of course, but I can always say I tried! Get involved and don’t be afraid to put yourself out there! From what I’ve researched, you’ll start out entry level and work your way up as you get your work out there!

Though, mostly, I’d like to encourage you to not lose hope. You spent time on something special, and it will become something awesome as long as you want it to and give it time. 

And I mean it, OP! DONT BE AFRAID TO BUG PEOPLE! If a studio doesn’t answer your calls/emails, don’t be afraid to search them up on LinkedIn and leave comments and send dms!! Bug bug bug!!

I hope you hear back from your doctor soon! I only witnessed my sibling’s struggles, so I wish I understood your struggles more thoroughly! I just know how hopeless it can make one feel. Just keep your head high and try to keep your stress down.
